details:
- CVE-2026-27879: cap the resampled series length in
  Series.Resample() at 1,000,000 points; the length was derived
  straight from the caller-supplied time range and interval and then
  allocated, so a crafted resample query could exhaust memory
- CVE-2026-28375: bound the testdata data-source result sizes that
  were taken unchecked from client-controlled maxDataPoints and line
  counts - log lines, randomWalkTable, the simulation engine and the
  USA scenario are each clamped to 10000 points
